name: Hemington Road and Goblin Brook

layers.essential_history: [[c:Hemington Road runs south past the church and crosses Goblin Brook, a stream with an unusual name. The old airfield lay a little to the south-east: the RAF used it from 1941, and the American 351st Bomb Group flew more than 300 missions from here between 1943 and 1945. The film star Clark Gable was stationed here during the war.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:In the 1950s the airfield was used for Thor missiles. In the village, a US flag on the war memorial and a roll of honour in the church remember the men of the 351st.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A farmer saw a man in a smart suit walking from the airfield fence with a camera, an hour after midnight.]]

evidence: [[c:A man in a smart suit was seen at the airfield fence with a camera after midnight.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:The countryside loop, about 2.7 km. Follow Hemington Road south-east out of the village for about 1.2 km. At the bend, take the footpath on the right heading west across the fields. Where it meets the lane, turn right and follow the lane north back to the village, to the end of Robert's Lane.]]
